note: Private IPA 674 on the delivered and verified 672, after every handoff of this round (MeloNX Core 673 handed over 6 November). RPCS3 Core 903 replaces Core 902: the native Metal 4 renderer gains stages M3 and M4 (the maintainer asked to finish the engine): textures through the texture cache (uploads, formats, samplers, render-to-texture, readback, the blit engine and scaled copies), exact occlusion queries read after GPU completion, conditional render on the exact result, MSAA, the conversion kernels and the native overlays (save, trophy and keyboard dialogs). Still opt-in per title: in-game menu, accuracy tests page, native Metal 4 engine; Automatic keeps Vulkan on MoltenVK, unchanged. Paths still missing are counted in the log. MeloNX Core 673 replaces Core 671: the main pipeline cache is checkpointed during play (worker thread, at most every 180 s, no skipped draw), so pipelines compiled in a session survive a crash and stutter should drop from the second session on (Hogwarts journals over two or three sessions wanted). No iPhone measurement; no FPS claim.
